//font: The candidate window's font family and pixel size. These, and how many candidates fit on a row, are the only parts of that window PIME lets an input method change: its colours come from GetSysColor inside the text service DLL and are not exposed. Nirmala UI ships with every Windows 10 and 11, so it is always present; Nirmala Text is the same family's reading face if you prefer looser letterforms.
//telemetry: off = nothing recorded (default). metrics = counters only, no text. full = counters + struggle words (typed string, chosen word, what we ranked first) ONLY when the first suggestion was not taken.
//telemetry_drop: UNC path or folder where each machine drops its own files, e.g. \\\\SERVER\\likhi-pilot. Empty means keep everything local.
//telemetry_endpoint: HTTPS ingest URL, e.g. https://likhi-ingest-xxxx.run.app/v1/ingest. Works alongside or instead of telemetry_drop.
//telemetry_sync_seconds: How often new lines are shipped, on a background thread. 900 = every 15 minutes.
